channel.description: Latest articles from New England Patriots (patriots.com)

item.title: 1985, Episode 10: "Legacy"
item.description: A reflective finale featuring voices from across the team, looking back 40 years later. Focuses on what the 1985 season meant to the players, the franchise, and the fans — and how it laid the foundation for everything that came after.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/3, Part 2: Seahawks Preview, Game Keys/Predictions, Frank Caliendo and Dianna Russini Interviews
item.description: Tune in for the second-half of Patriots Unfiltered Radio Row debut show! We talk the matchup between the Patriots and Seahawks and share keys to the game, matchups to watch and a few predictions. We hear from callers, listen to their opinions and discuss takes on Will Campbell's consistency, which QB has more to prove, Gonzo on JSN. Plus, we are joined by more special guests, including comedian Frank Caliendo, Dianna Russini from the Athletic and more!

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/4, Part 2: Super Bowl LX Preview, Matchups and Schematics, Trey Flowers, Doug Flutie and Lonnie Paxton Interviews
item.description: Tune in for part two of the Patriots Unfiltered second-edition show live from Radio Row in San Francisco! We dive into schematics on both sides of the ball to analyze how each offense and defense matchup, what weaknesses can be exploited and how the Patriots could best use their strengths. Plus, special guests Trey Flowers, Doug Flutie and Lonnie Paxton join the show!

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/4, Part 1: Super Bowl LX Preview, Patriots News/Updates, Mina Kimes, Howard Balzer and Dr. Chao Interviews
item.description: Tune in to the second edition of Patriots Unfiltered direct from Radio Row as the Patriots prepare for Super Bowl LX. We preview the matchup, and discuss ways New England could expose the Seahawks on both sides of the ball. We talk team news and updates on mentality, injuries and more from Head Coach and player press conferences. Plus, special guests Mina Kimes from ESPN, veteran reporter Howard Balzer and Dr. Chao - the Pro Football Doc joins the show!

item.title: Patriots Catch-22: Super Bowl LX Preview, Players/Matchups to Watch, Special Guests Benjamin Solak (ESPN) and Shawn Syed (Sumner Sports)
item.description: Tune in as Evan Lazar and Alex Barth go live from Radio Row in San Francisco in this special Super Bowl LX edition of Catch-22. They preview the Patriots-Seahawks matchup with keys to the game, schemes to look out for, and players to watch. They talk the NFL Honors and make their picks for the season's most coveted awards. Plus, special guests Benjamin Solak from ESPN and Shawn Syed from Sumner Sports join the show to share their perspectives!

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/5, Part 1: Super Bowl LX Preview, Team Updates, Ted Karras, Gregg Rosenthal, Brian Hoyer, and Matt Hasselbeck Interviews
item.description: Tune in as we go live for the third edition of Patriots Unfiltered from Radio Row ahead of Super Bowl LX. We discuss team updates on injuries and more following comments in the Patriots final pressers of the week. We talk the NFL Honors and the Patriots who are nominated for the league's most prestigious awards. Plus, special guests Ted Karras, Gregg Rosenthal, Brian Hoyer and Matt Hasselbeck stop by to discuss the Super Bowl matchup, NFL Awards picks, and the Patriots stellar season.

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/5, Part 2: SB LX Matchups to Watch, NFL Honors Predictions, Matt Cassel, Deatrich Wise, and Brian Hoyer Interviews
item.description: Tune in for part two of the third edition of Patriots Unfiltered live from Radio Row in San Francisco! We continue previewing Super Bowl LX with matchups to watch on the line of scrimmage, downfield, and on special teams. We preview the NFL Honors Awards Ceremony, talk current and former Patriots who may be awarded, and make our predictions for who will take home the hardware. item.title: Patriots Unfiltered 2/6, Part 1: NFL Honors Recap, Keys to Super Bowl LX, Special Guests, Taylor Lewan, Mike Reiss, Maura Healey and more!
item.description: Tune in as we go live for our fourth and final edition of Patriots Unfiltered from Radio Row in San Francisco! We recap the NFL Honors Awards and talk Mike Vrabel winning Coach of the Year for the second time, and the slim margin that decided the MVP race. We begin our final preview of Super Bowl LX with keys to the game and matchups to watch. Plus, former Patriot Robert Gallery, Taylor Lewan from Bussin' with the Boys, Mike Reiss from ESPN, Massachusetts Governor Maura Healey, and more!

item.title: Patriots Unfiltered: Super Bowl LX Recap, Season Closing Thoughts, Mapping Out the Offseason
item.description: Tune in as the PU crew breaks down the Patriots Super Bowl LX loss to the Seahawks. We shed light on positive takeaways, including the secondary's performance from players Christian Gonzalez and Craig Woodson. item.title: Patriots Catch-22: Super Bowl LX Recap, Up/Down Takeaways, Offseason Outlook
item.description: Tune in as Evan Lazar and Alex Barth recap the Patriots Super Bowl LX loss to the Seahawks. They discuss positive and negative takeaways, including the offensive line's performance, coaching decisions, run defense, and more. They reflect on the 2025 season as a whole and comment on the culture shift, locker room, and player development. Plus, they look ahead to the offseason, as the combine, draft, and minicamp festivities are set to kick off in the next few months.
